name: Subash Singh Parajuli

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Subash Singh Parajuli is a poet and literary organiser from Nepal. His poetry collections include Mystic Myth, Soil on Pyre and Symphony of Life, and he has also worked on the international anthology Pandemic Poetry 2020. In a 2024 interview with The Hemingway Post, he described translation, cultural exchange and workshops as ways to bring Nepali poetry to a wider readership.

‘While searching for the peace’ repeatedly measures the promise of peace against greed, exploitation and failures of human care. Its refrain moves through religion, luxury, science and intimate relationships, building a restless public lament. The accompanying ‘An untold tale of street’ in the March contribution narrows that concern to an abandoned child, using the responses of trees, birds and dogs to expose the absence of human protection.
